title: Barghsa Executive SLO
description: Availability, error budget and end-to-end API latency for a selected environment and database.

panels.title: Observed journey availability
panels.description: Successful eligible attempts divided by all observed eligible attempts in the selected period. Timeouts and critical dependency failures are recorded by the journey collector. No data appears without both outcomes and observed attempts.

panels.title: Remaining journey error budget
panels.description: Fraction of the allowed failure budget left in the selected period at the chosen availability target. A negative result means the service exceeded its budget.

panels.title: Journey error-budget burn rate
panels.description: Observed failure fraction divided by the allowed error fraction, per service. A rate of 1 consumes the budget at the allowed pace. Gaps indicate insufficient observations.

panels.title: API latency
panels.description: End-to-end p95 and p99 for completed responses by HTTP method. Journey availability includes timeouts and failures that never produce a response.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (method, le) (rate(barghsa_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{environment="$environment",database="$database"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (method) (sum by (method) (rate(barghsa_http_request_duration_seconds_count{environment="$environment",database="$database"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (method, le) (rate(barghsa_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{environment="$environment",database="$database"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (method) (sum by (method) (rate(barghsa_http_request_duration_seconds_count{environment="$environment",database="$database"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Observed journey attempts
panels.description: Success and failure volumes over the selected period. Check that all four services and both outcomes have coverage before using the availability or budget figures.

panels.title: Last synthetic run age
panels.description: Time since each independent runner completed a check. Compare with the five-minute schedule and the 12-minute freshness bound.

panels.title: Last executed synthetic checks
panels.description: Passed or failed checks from a fresh independent run. Checks skipped after a failed prerequisite have no result.

targets.expr: barghsa_synthetic_probe_success{job="barghsa-synthetic",environment="$environment",database="$database"} and on (job, instance, environment, database) barghsa:synthetic_probe:fresh and on (job, instance, environment, database) (up{job="barghsa-synthetic"} == 1)

panels.title: Journey error-budget burn-down
panels.description: Remaining fraction of the allowed failure budget from the selected start through each observed five-minute sample. The UTC month is selected by default. Missing measurements leave gaps. Negative values indicate an exceeded budget.

panels.title: Public HTTPS certificate remaining
panels.description: Shortest verified leaf certificate lifetime reported by current independent probes for this scope. The P3 warning starts at 14 days.
